items.headline: Scheduled prompts are one of the most practical and underused Microsoft Copilot features
items.summary: Scheduled prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot can run questions automatically on a daily, weekly, or monthly cadence and surface results when needed. When you return from vacation, instead of spending days catching up by watching recordings, you can quickly read a text summary of each meeting. This transforms Copilot from a reactive chat window into a proactive automation tool that surfaces reminders at the right time and carries useful context forward.

items.headline: EU AI Act high-risk AI deadline deferred from August 2026 to December 2027
items.summary: Under the Digital Omnibus, a provisional agreement reached on 7 May 2026 and pending formal adoption, the high-risk AI deadline for Annex III systems is deferred from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027. Prohibited practices have been enforceable since 2 February 2025 and GPAI model rules since 2 August 2025. The EU AI Act will be fully applicable on 2 August 2026, with the exception of the Annex III high-risk systems deferral.
